title: 第11章 杀人狂魔这是一个圈套第12章 又欧了史诗词条
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: “落丁村为何被屠呢……”
这个问题不止模拟里的陈奕疑惑，模拟外的陈奕也时常思索。
“话说回来，还是得接触武者，这不有新功法了？”
陈奕知道三姐夫是一名武者，所以每次能选择投奔三姐的时候，都会这么选。
自己在江湖上乱蹿，可能根本就进不了武者的圈子，一直和凡人打交道可不行。
模拟中，沈青山为陈奕介绍了一些武道的基本知识。
比如，对平民来说，武道有六个境界：
炼体、聚灵、淬魂、金身、灵海、凝神。
为什么要加个“对平民来说”
呢。
沈青山解释道。
“因为凝神之上的境界和平民没关系，能修炼到凝神境已经是万中无一的人中龙凤。”
还有功法的品质：
低阶、中阶、高阶、地阶、天阶之分。
沈青山表示。
“地阶、天阶功法可以当它们不存在，它们每个都可视作战略级资源，被皇室、顶尖武者势力牢牢掌控，哪怕对自己人都不轻易传授。
像我们这样的普通武者，能有一本高阶功法，都属于机缘深厚了。”
沈家曾经辉煌过。
如今家道衰败到，只剩沈青山一个人，他还能保住四本中阶功法，已经属于老祖宗在地下求了所有关系的程度。
当一个势力衰弱以后，她的资源肯定会被更强的势力瓜分，很难留给后人。
沈青山给陈奕的四本功法，分别是外功《正阳诀》、内功《烈心诀》，武学《沈家枪》、《焚云手》。
武学是用来战斗的，一个枪法，一个类似掌法。
外功修炼血气，陈奕上一世模拟已经知道了。
而内功则是修炼灵气的。
当武者达到炼体九段，血气提升至极限后，就需要通过修炼内功凝练灵气，进而突破至下一个境界——聚灵境！
沈青山就是一位聚灵境武者。
在小小的县城里，能有聚灵境修为，属于实力很靠前的武者了。
而沈青山，在斩妖司的职位也不普通，他是一名小旗官，手下有一支十几人的斩妖人队伍。
【第二年，十九岁。
【开始词条抽取……】
【抽取成功！

content_en:
"Why was Luoding Village massacred..."
This question is not only puzzled by Chen Yi in the simulation, Chen Yi outside the simulation also often thinks about it.
"Having said that, you still have to get in touch with warriors. Isn't there a new technique?"
Chen Yi knew that the third brother-in-law was a warrior, so every time he could choose to join the third sister, he would do so.
If you wander around in the world, you may not be able to enter the circle of warriors at all, and you can't keep dealing with mortals.
During the simulation, Shen Qingshan introduced some basic knowledge of martial arts to Chen Yi.
For example, for civilians, martial arts has six realms:
Body refining, spirit gathering, soul quenching, golden body, spiritual sea, and concentration.
Why add “for civilians”?
Yet.
Shen Qingshan explained.
"Because the realm above Concentration has nothing to do with ordinary people. Those who can cultivate to the realm of Concentration are already unique among thousands of people."
And the quality of the exercises:
They are divided into low level, middle level, high level, earth level and heaven level.
Shen Qingshan said.
"Earth-level and heaven-level skills can be treated as if they don't exist. Each of them can be regarded as a strategic resource. They are firmly controlled by the royal family and top warriors, and they are not easily taught even to their own people.
For ordinary warriors like us to have a copy of high-level skills, it is because of deep luck. "
The Shen family once had a glorious time.
Now that the family has declined to the point where Shen Qingshan is the only one left, he can still keep the four intermediate skills, which is to the extent that his ancestors have all the connections underground.
When a force weakens, its resources will definitely be divided up by stronger forces, making it difficult to leave them to future generations.
Shen Qingshan gave Chen Yi four Kung Fu books, namely the external Kung Fu "Zheng Yang Jue", the internal Kung Fu "Fierce Heart Jue", and the martial arts "Shen Family Spear" and "Fire Cloud Hand".
Martial arts are used for fighting, one is the spear technique, the other is similar to the palm technique.
Chen Yi already knew about the external skills of cultivating blood energy in his previous life.
Internal strength is about cultivating spiritual energy.
When a warrior reaches the ninth stage of body refining and his blood energy reaches the limit, he needs to condense his spiritual energy through practicing internal skills, and then break through to the next realm - the spirit gathering realm!
Shen Qingshan is a spiritual gathering realm warrior.
In a small county town, a warrior with the spirit-gathering realm is considered to be a very powerful warrior.
As for Shen Qingshan, his position in the Demon Slayer Division is not ordinary. He is a small flag officer and has a team of more than a dozen demon slayers under his command.
